description: This file defines a mock class for the WebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory interface used in unit testing. It includes mock methods for creating WebAudioPlayer instances and server internal WebAudioPlayers, and references external interfaces and libraries such as Google Mock.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory for testing purposes.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a mock WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a mock WebAudioPlayer server internal instance with specified parameters including shared memory buffer and handle.
